title: Development session manifest
description: What one development session created and may therefore remove. Cleanup deletes from this record and from nothing else: a resource that is not listed was not created by the session and is not the session's to delete.

session_id.description: Identifies the session that owns every resource below. Cleanup refuses a manifest without one, because ownership is what separates a session's own scratch space from the machine it runs on.

session_root.description: The one directory a session may create paths under. Every path resource must resolve inside it.

type.description: Only these are removable. An unknown type is a resource this controller does not understand well enough to delete safely.

id.description: An absolute path for path types, or the runtime name/id for the rest.

owner_session.description: Must equal session_id. A resource labelled for another session is that session's to remove.

ownership_proof.description: How the session knows it created this: the label it stamped, or the fact it made the path. Absent proof is a refusal, never a best-effort delete.

retention.description: disposable is the only class cleanup may destroy. release bytes, canonical source, acceptance evidence and anything shared outlive the session that produced them.
